about.title: Twenty-nine years of practice, condensed into every seminar.
about.intro: Stephen Kirwin is a neuromuscular therapist and bodywork educator with over two decades of clinical practice and a roster of elite athletes, performers, and wellness destinations behind him. Meet the practitioner behind the seminars.
bio: Stephen Kirwin is a neuromuscular therapist and bodywork educator with more than twenty-nine years of clinical practice. He studied at the University of Colorado, Boulder and the Boulder College of Massage Therapy, then went on to refine his hands-on approach in the treatment room for decades.

From 1995 to 1998 he worked at the CU Physical Therapy Center in Boulder, followed by seven years running his own private practice in Boulder from 1998 to 2005. Those years built the assessment-driven, results-focused method that still anchors every seminar he teaches today.

Stephen has worked with twelve-time Ironman competitors and elite athletes including Scott Tinley and Dave Scott, and was selected to work with Lance Armstrong's Tour de France team. His client list has also included actors Kevin Spacey and Oliver Stone, reflecting the precision and discretion his work demands.

Today he lives and teaches from Hong Kong, training practitioners across Asia in a calm, methodical approach that prioritizes results in the treatment room and sustainability for the practitioner delivering the work.
credentials: Specialist in neuromuscular therapy and deep tissue bodywork
about.approachBody: Stephen integrates several therapeutic modalities to read the body, release holding patterns, and build a clear plan for change.
about.partnersBody: Stephen has worked with leading wellness centers and destination spas across Asia, Europe, and beyond.

about.faqIntro: Quick answers to the questions Stephen hears most often from prospective students and clients.

faqs.question: What is neuromuscular therapy?
faqs.answer: Neuromuscular therapy is a precise, assessment-driven approach to soft-tissue work that targets trigger points, muscular holding patterns, and posture-related pain. Stephen integrates it with deep tissue and structural techniques for measurable, repeatable results.

faqs.question: Who is Stephen Kirwin?
faqs.answer: Stephen is a neuromuscular therapist and bodywork educator with more than twenty-nine years of clinical practice. He studied at the University of Colorado, Boulder and the Boulder College of Massage Therapy, and has worked with elite athletes, performers, and leading wellness destinations.

faqs.question: Where is the school located?
faqs.answer: The school is based at 218 Jaffe Road, Suite 602, Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Stephen also travels throughout Asia for private cohorts.

faqs.question: Can beginners join?
faqs.answer: Yes. The seminars are built to support both newcomers and experienced practitioners. Beginners receive additional context on anatomy and assessment, while experienced students focus on refining hands-on technique.

faqs.question: What qualifications are required?
faqs.answer: No formal prerequisite is required for the foundational seminars. A background in bodywork, physiotherapy, or movement practice is helpful but not mandatory. Reach out via the contact page if you are unsure whether the seminars are right for you.

faqs.question: How do I register?
faqs.answer: Browse the upcoming sessions on the courses page and reserve your seat through the booking form. Each cohort is intentionally small, so early registration is recommended.

faqs.question: Will I receive a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students who complete the seminar receive a certificate of completion. Final assessments on Day 4 confirm the techniques you have learned.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Comfortable clothing that allows full range of motion, a notebook, and a willingness to give and receive hands-on work. Massage tables and all oils are provided on site.

faqs.question: What topics will be covered?
faqs.answer: Anatomy and physiology, palpation, neuromuscular assessment, deep tissue and myofascial techniques, treatment planning, ethics, and the business practices needed to run a sustainable bodywork practice.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: Use the contact page to send a message. Stephen reads every note personally and replies within two business days.

courses.title: Upcoming seminars
courses.subtitle: Intensive Training in neuromuscular therapy and restorative bodywork.
courses.overviewBody: Join us for an intensive four-day course designed to equip aspiring massage therapists with essential skills in both general massage therapy and specialized neuromuscular therapy techniques. This hands-on program combines theoretical knowledge with practical applications to enhance your competence and confidence in the field.
courses.highlightsTitle: What you will cover each day.
courses.highlightsIntro: A progressive four-day intensive that moves from foundational massage through advanced neuromuscular therapy and into the practice of running a sustainable bodywork business.

highlights.day1Body: An introduction to massage modalities, anatomy and physiology, the basic techniques that anchor every session, and the communication skills that turn a treatment into a therapeutic relationship.
highlights.day2Body: Neuromuscular anatomy and trigger points, assessment strategies for reading the body, and structured hands-on practice to build confidence with the foundational NMT approach.
highlights.day3Body: Integrating NMT with traditional massage, designing treatment protocols for common client presentations, and guided practice that refines your hands-on decision making.
highlights.day4Body: Building a sustainable bodywork practice, the ethics and boundaries that protect both client and practitioner, and the final assessments that earn your certificate of completion.
